clock: 1.2 GHz (833.3 ps), SS setup 60 ps uncertainty (asap7 RVT SS), FF hold 25 ps (asap7 RVT FF), corner_sta on routed 6_final odb+spef

run_descriptions.pair1: ot_v41_pq_pair_screen PQ=1: per-pair loader with pending load + element banked output tags, op parity, bank guard, 340-bit configuration shadow and its copy (all new per-pair hardware), register-bounded as in the pair; io delay 20%
run_descriptions.pair0: the same top at PQ=0 (pinned loader, single-bank tags, no shadow): the per-pair baseline
run_descriptions.spw1: ot_v41_pq_spine_screen PQ=1, R=16, KMAX 256, PHW 6, SAW 8 (register-file ROMs), pinned quantisers stubbed, neighbours registered (false-path io)
run_descriptions.spw0: the same spine wrapper at PQ=0 (one op in flight): baseline of the inherited spine structure
run_descriptions.spw128: spw1 at the die's R=128 region roots (480 um die for the 19,355 pins)

verdict_ssff: FAIL: the per-pair hardware closes (SS +140.0 ps, FF +5.0 ps, 0 violations, routed); the PQ spine does not close at SS (R=16 -722.8 ps / 6,609 pins; R=128 -905.9 ps / 12,925 pins, FF -10.3 ps at R=128). The same wrapper at PQ=0 fails SS -684.1 ps / 5,382 pins on the same register classes (stream-ROM word sw, row-write w_addr/w_data, beat assembly bt_q*/bt_d, x buffer bb, sm_i): the inherited pinned-spine one-cycle loops (stream ROM read -> beat need vs loaded count -> next address; pos*ops row address) are the limiter; the PQ-only registers (since1/2 -548 ps, s_rl -444 ps, ga -427 ps, bufbusy -502 ps) sit in the same streamer-end cone and also fail.

physical_cost.area_basis: routed std-cell area difference PQ=1 minus PQ=0 of the same screen tops (pair: per element; spine: per die, R=16 wrapper); 2417 pairs, 128 regions per layer die, 324 S81 layer dies; no macros added. S81 die priced 839.239 mm2 of the 858 mm2 reticle: +1.9786 mm2 fits (margin 18.761 -> 16.782 mm2)
physical_cost.r93_replacement: one more BF16-capable pair site in region 93 of every layer die (519 -> 520): one q element replaced by a BF element (bf vs q element area per S81 floorplan area_mm2_by_kind / counts)
physical_cost.added_spine_wires: broadcast +2 bits (go_tag) through the BST trunk; return tag reuses row bits [15:14] (no new wires); spine flops: 4 op slots (ph, xbase, obase, ops, xps, fmt, 64-bit phase word, rsplit, 19-bit rows-left, np) + since counters + 2-stage per-tag row-count tree
physical_cost.slack_basis: routed (ORFS detail route, RCX spef), OpenSTA SS/FF corner_sta; block level, not in the S81 die
physical_cost.congestion_basis: BLOCK-LEVEL route GRT (asap7 M2-M7, adjustment 0.25) of each screen top, 4x4-GCell windows from its 4_cts.odb (physical/dsrom_recovery_field/gcell4x4.sh); NOT the S81 full-die GRT. Boundary tracks added across region/spine: +2 broadcast bits (go_tag) only
physical_cost.s81_rerun_why: element (pair) abstract grows by the per-element area above (banked tags + configuration shadow); one more BF site in region 93 (R93 re-placement); spine gains op slots and a 2-bit wider broadcast; the S81 full-die physical PASS was for the pinned element/spine
